title: Al Nassr vs Al Kholood LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch Saudi Pro League 2026-27

 Al Nassr vs Al Kholood LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch Saudi Pro League 2026-27
 By Sushruta Follow Add as Preferred Source From football pitches to bookshelves, always chasing a good story. Published at : October 29, 2026 at 10:30 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 29, 2026 at 10:30 PM (GMT+5:30) The hosts will be the heavy favourites tonight.
 Al Nassr will host Al Kholood in a fixture of the Saudi Pro League 2026-27 at Al-Awwal Park on Thursday night. The hosts enter this fixture on the back of an impressive four-match winning streak, but will need to be at their best against Al Kholood.
 The Knights of Najd have won eight of their 10 league matches so far, sitting second in the table with 25 points. They have won three league matches on the trot. Their last outing was a 3-1 win away to Al Faisaly, with Abdullah Al Hamdan and Angelo scoring.
 Ange Postecoglou will hope that his side can continue their five-match unbeaten streak in the league. The hosts have scored 23 goals in the league, which is the fourth-best output in the league. They will rely on Cristiano Ronaldo , who recently won the Ballon d’Or BOAT Award.
 Al Kholood, meanwhile, sit in ninth place with 12 points. They have lost four successive league matches. Des Buckingham’s side suffered a 3-0 home thrashing at the hands of Al Ettifaq in their last outing. Their defence has been leaky all season, conceding 21 goals – the second-worst record in the league.

 Where and how to live stream Al Nassr vs Al Kholood in India?

 Where and how to watch Saudi Pro League live in the UK?
 Fans in the UK can watch this match live in the DAZN app and website.
 Where and how to watch Al Nassr vs Al Kholood live in Saudi Arabia?
 In Saudi Arabia, the match will be shown live on the Thmanyah platform.
 Where and how to watch Saudi Pro League live in the USA?
 Fans in the USA can watch the match live on Fox Soccer Plus, FuboTV, FOX Deportes, and FOX One.
 When is Al Nassr vs Al Kholood match in Saudi Pro League 2026-27?
 The match will take place on Thursday, October 29, 2026, with kick-off scheduled for 11:30 PM IST.
 Where will Al Nassr vs Al Kholood be played?
 The match will be played at Al-Awwal Park in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in the Saudi Pro League 2026-27.
